title: App owns stack snapshot
description: All data fetching and error state; layout lives under shell.
body: Owns the stack snapshot and hands it to the shell. All this does is data: fetch, refresh, and error state. Everything about how the app looks and what it shows lives under `shell/`. Keeping the fetch here rather than inside the shell means the shell can be restyled or rearranged without anything having to know how the snapshot is obtained.
